import Box from '@mui/material/Box';
import { Typography } from '@mui/material';

<Box
  sx={{
    mt: 10,
    py: 5,
    textAlign: "center",
    background: "#0f172a",
    color: "white",
  }}
>

  <Typography
    variant="h5"
    fontWeight={700}
    gutterBottom
  >
    DevBlog
  </Typography>

  <Typography
    variant="body2"
    sx={{ opacity: 0.7 }}
  >
    Built with MERN Stack &
    Material UI
  </Typography>

</Box>
